blocks.text: Sibol, the Philippines’ esports contingent, clinched another bronze medal, this time in the Honor of Kings tournament at the 2026 Asian Games after loss against powerhouse China, 0-2, in the semifinals on Monday at the Aichi-Sky Expo Hall.
